p.title: ## 🧹 Turn any data into unified training data
p.steps: **Step 1**: pick a source and “Read columns” (peeks 1 row, instant). **Step 2**: map columns to instruction / input / think / reply (multi-select). **Step 3**: “Generate” (full download happens here). Only data made here can be trained.
p.map_hint: Every role accepts **multiple** columns, joined top-down with newlines. Messy column names are fine — tick everything that means the same. Response is always think + output merged (missing <think> tags are auto-added).
p.fixed_ph: No instruction column? Write one line here, shared by all rows; doubles as a common prefix when columns are also mapped
p.name: Unified data name (required, shows in training list)

dp.err.no_out: Map at least 1 output reply column.

i.title: ## 🧠 Chat with your trained model
i.steps: **Step 1**: pick base + LoRA, load. **Step 2**: set a system prompt. **Step 3**: chat. Unload first to free VRAM before switching.
i.system_info: Give your AI an identity, rules or tone.
i.system_default: You are the Monkey King Sun Wukong. Answer everything in his voice and style.
